name: tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae
statement: ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) μ) (hfg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) : TendstoInMeasure μ f atTop g

name: exists_seq_tendstoInMeasure_atTop_iff
statement: ℕ → α → E} (hf : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) μ) {g : α → E} : TendstoInMeasure μ f atTop g ↔ ∀ ns : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ns → ∃ ns' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ns' ∧ ∀ᵐ (ω : α) ∂μ, Tendsto (fun i ↦ f (ns (ns' i)) ω) atTop (𝓝 (g ω))
